name: Diff
description: Unified diffs and git patches — `.patch`, `.diff`, `.rej`, by patterns.

patterns.re: ^(?:diff --git |diff --cc |index |--- |\+\+\+ |old mode |new mode |new file mode |deleted file mode |similarity index |dissimilarity index |rename from |rename to |copy from |copy to |Binary files |GIT binary patch).*
^\\ No newline at end of file.*
